DeterminationBasis: T01-001 directly establishes that consequential evaluation begins from an identifiable complete governing state and requires that state to be established and referenced before determination or execution. This directly covers the requirement that a consequential determination reference an identifiable governing state.

The current T01 suite establishes complete governing state, explicit scope, changed-state handling, missing-predicate failure and successor correction, but does not directly require the Governing State Object to identify the subject, system, actor or other identity to which that state applies.
